_about: Reviewed changes to expected answers. The frozen scenario-truth.json is never edited; the scorer applies these on top, and each records who decided, when and why.

amendments.policy: Before accepting a dispute, the merchant must know it has not already refunded the customer; a carrier confirming the parcel lost does not establish that.
amendments.reason: In batch-20261009T001752Z the agent proposed the original expected answer (accept) after the carrier reported the parcel lost; the refund-status guard refused it because no record shows whether a refund was issued. Asking costs the merchant a minute; a double refund costs money.
